release_notes: Complete modern redesign built on one central design system, with light, dark and Follow-Windows themes and immediate theme switching.
Collapsible navigation rail, contextual toolbar and accessible keyboard controls across Dashboard, downloads, Video Downloads, Browser Assistant, Scheduler, History and Settings.
Live dashboard and virtualized download list with search, sorting, categories and per-row progress that stay responsive with thousands of items.
Searchable Settings with fourteen sections and real actions for browser registration, verified backup and restore, update checks and diagnostics.
Download engine, SQLite schema v4, browser extensions, native messaging and the signed updater are unchanged; existing settings, history and partial downloads are preserved.
